displayName: Headcount Labs — Job Search & Hiring Data
description: Use when the user asks to find jobs, search current job postings, count how many jobs match a role/company/place, get salary ranges, or analyze the job market (top employers, top metros, remote vs on-site split, pay transparency). Covers job search, hiring data, labor-market questions, and "who is hiring for X". Not for applying to jobs or writing resumes.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
